source.title: Watering Down the Competition
source.description:
The time for defense is over! We won't win unless we sabotage the competition! Their fuel! Lets see. Firebloom and Rum? THIS IS WHAT GNOMISH INGENUITY IS LOSING TO? STEEPED ALCOHOL?

We need to find a way to sabotage the enemy fuel without them noticing. There is a flower of incredible red color, the compounds of the petals are unstable when the smallest amount of heat is applied.

The Scarlet Crusade uses this flower in their dyes. Go to Hearthglen and find me some.
source.objective: Go to Hearthglen and find a Box of Scarlet Dye.
source.progress: The Scarlet Crusade are the only ones who know of the flowers whereabouts! The compounds are strong enough that it should be concentrated enough in their dyes.
source.completion: You found it! Yes, simply slipping this into the enemies gas tank should cause quite the spectacle! An explosion? No worse! They will be operating at only 76% capacity! And they won't even know it!
